import __vite__cjsImport0__ton_core from "/node_modules/.vite/deps/@ton_core.js?v=c9a499e6"; const Address = __vite__cjsImport0__ton_core["Address"]; const beginCell = __vite__cjsImport0__ton_core["beginCell"]; const Cell = __vite__cjsImport0__ton_core["Cell"]; const toNano = __vite__cjsImport0__ton_core["toNano"]; const TupleBuilder = __vite__cjsImport0__ton_core["TupleBuilder"]; const TupleReader = __vite__cjsImport0__ton_core["TupleReader"]






;
import __vite__cjsImport1__ton_ton from "/node_modules/.vite/deps/@ton_ton.js?v=eed78996"; const TonClient = __vite__cjsImport1__ton_ton["TonClient"];
import { DECIMALS, MINTER, RPC } from "/src/config.ts";
const OP = {
  EnableTrading: 1455545190,
  SetSellEnabled: 3304390616,
  SetDexLimitsEnabled: 2892774684,
  SetBlacklist: 2072896655,
  PushWalletConfig: 677324105,
  DepositTreasury: 1591581524,
  JettonTransfer: 260734629,
  BatchTransfer: 4166427418
};
export function client() {
  return new TonClient({ endpoint: RPC });
}
export function toUnits(amount) {
  const [i, f = ""] = String(amount).trim().split(".");
  const frac = (f + "000000000").slice(0, Number(DECIMALS));
  return BigInt(i || "0") * 10n ** DECIMALS + BigInt(frac || "0");
}
export function fromUnits(v) {
  const neg = v < 0n;
  const x = neg ? -v : v;
  const base = 10n ** DECIMALS;
  const whole = x / base;
  const frac = (x % base).toString().padStart(Number(DECIMALS), "0").replace(/0+$/, "");
  return `${neg ? "-" : ""}${whole}${frac ? "." + frac : ""}`;
}
let qid = BigInt(Date.now() % 1e6);
function nextQ() {
  qid += 1n;
  return qid;
}
function storeOp(op) {
  return beginCell().storeUint(op, 32).storeUint(nextQ(), 64);
}
export function bodyEnableTrading() {
  return storeOp(OP.EnableTrading).endCell();
}
export function bodySetSell(enabled) {
  return storeOp(OP.SetSellEnabled).storeBit(enabled).endCell();
}
export function bodyDexLimits(enabled) {
  return storeOp(OP.SetDexLimitsEnabled).storeBit(enabled).endCell();
}
export function bodyBlacklist(account, blocked) {
  return storeOp(OP.SetBlacklist).storeAddress(Address.parse(account)).storeBit(blocked).endCell();
}
export function bodyPushConfig(walletOwner) {
  return storeOp(OP.PushWalletConfig).storeAddress(Address.parse(walletOwner)).endCell();
}
export function bodyDepositTreasury() {
  return storeOp(OP.DepositTreasury).endCell();
}
export function bodyJettonTransfer(amount, destination, response) {
  return beginCell().storeUint(OP.JettonTransfer, 32).storeUint(nextQ(), 64).storeCoins(amount).storeAddress(Address.parse(destination)).storeAddress(Address.parse(response)).storeBit(false).storeCoins(toNano("0.01")).storeBit(false).endCell();
}
export function bodyBatchTransfer(items) {
  if (items.length < 1 || items.length > 150) throw new Error("Batch 1..150");
  let payload = beginCell().storeUint(items.length, 8);
  for (const it of items) {
    payload = payload.storeAddress(Address.parse(it.to)).storeCoins(it.amount);
  }
  return storeOp(OP.BatchTransfer).storeRef(payload.endCell()).endCell();
}
export async function fetchLiveState() {
  const c = client();
  const minter = Address.parse(MINTER);
  const trading = await c.runMethod(minter, "get_trading_state");
  const tr = new TupleReader(trading.stack);
  const isTradingEnabled = tr.readBoolean();
  const isSellEnabled = tr.readBoolean();
  const isDexLimitsEnabled = tr.readBoolean();
  const dexPool = tr.readAddressOpt();
  tr.readNumber();
  tr.readNumber();
  tr.readNumber();
  tr.readBigNumber();
  tr.readBigNumber();
  tr.readAddress();
  const claim = await c.runMethod(minter, "get_claim_status");
  const cr = new TupleReader(claim.stack);
  const cycleId = Number(cr.readNumber());
  const cycleStart = Number(cr.readNumber());
  const claimWindowOpen = cr.readBoolean();
  const claimWindowEnd = Number(cr.readNumber());
  cr.readBigNumber();
  cr.readBigNumber();
  cr.readBoolean();
  const claimProgramActive = cr.readBoolean();
  const treas = await c.runMethod(minter, "get_treasury_balance");
  const treasury = new TupleReader(treas.stack).readBigNumber();
  const jd = await c.runMethod(minter, "get_jetton_data");
  const jr = new TupleReader(jd.stack);
  const totalSupply = jr.readBigNumber();
  return {
    isTradingEnabled,
    isSellEnabled,
    isDexLimitsEnabled,
    dexPool: dexPool ? dexPool.toString() : null,
    treasury,
    totalSupply,
    cycleStart,
    claimWindowOpen,
    claimProgramActive,
    cycleId,
    claimWindowEnd
  };
}
export async function fetchHolder(addr) {
  const c = client();
  const tb = new TupleBuilder();
  tb.writeAddress(Address.parse(addr));
  const res = await c.runMethod(Address.parse(MINTER), "get_holder_info", tb.build());
  const r = new TupleReader(res.stack);
  return {
    balance: r.readBigNumber(),
    lastUpdate: Number(r.readNumber()),
    minBalancePeriod: r.readBigNumber(),
    periodStartBalance: r.readBigNumber(),
    claimedCycleId: Number(r.readNumber())
  };
}
export async function isBlacklisted(addr) {
  const c = client();
  const tb = new TupleBuilder();
  tb.writeAddress(Address.parse(addr));
  const res = await c.runMethod(Address.parse(MINTER), "is_blacklisted", tb.build());
  return new TupleReader(res.stack).readBoolean();
}
export { toNano, Address, Cell };
